steps.text: The wind blows gently, tugging your sleeves like a mischievous child.
It brings many scents to share: the earthy aroma of freshly squeezed rapeseed oil, the crisp freshness of neatly stacked rice straws, and the fragrance of rice stir-fried in the pan.
And so, you know all that is happening in these fields.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shu said she passed through fields like these on her way from Dahuang to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: Are they wheat fields?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Not just wheat, but also rice, sorghum, and sometimes just wild grass, many plants whose names I don't know, all growing so tall.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: A narrow dirt road extended out from the field. It had just rained, and there were pesky mud pits all over the place.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: No, Grain Buds, please, no rain!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Alright. It was sunny.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: It was sunny, and the bugs and fowlbeasts chirped happily.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: That's right. The sun made the grass nice and toasty. Bugs that can't take the heat went to hide in the shade.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Sounds so nice...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Dozing off already? Don't forget you promised to go to bed after this story, all of you. The doctors say you need to get lots of sleep.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: What about you, Grain Buds? Are you going to bed, or are you gonna wait for Shu?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: She won't be coming today because she has so much to do. I'll get some rest too, once you all fall asleep. I don't want this cold to get any worse.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Keep going, Grain Buds—we'll be good.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: A truck came rolling from afar, filled with fresh grain, and a thick layer of straw on top.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: Why is there straw on top?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: The young farmer driving the truck was in a hurry to get the food to the granary. He put a layer of straw over the grain, just in case it rained.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But he's worried...

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Why is there a dark cloud following me on a sunny day?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: I need to go faster. If it rains...

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Wh-What happened?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Don't worry, no one got hurt. But he found that the road before him was blocked as soon as he turned the corner.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Whose stockbeast and burdenbeast are these? Get them out of the way!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But nobody answered.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: He walked up to the burdenbeast, but there was no bridle on its neck, nor tag on its ears. The stockbeast had a saddle, but he couldn't get it to move, no matter how hard he pulled.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: The dark cloud got closer. The anxious farmer got an idea and pulled a handful of straw from the truck.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Here! You can have this, if you come over here!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Over here, over here—

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Even the animals ignored him!

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: What did he do?

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Why wouldn't they move?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: What do I do? My grain will be ruined if it rains!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Wait, this isn't a trap to rob me, right? Is there somebody hiding in the trees?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: He was just imagining things.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Go! Shoo! Get lost!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: I think I have a whip in my truck for cutting through dense grass.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Grain Buds...
The young farmer took out the whip, but hesitated. The burdenbeast and stockbeast looked at him placidly, without fear, without moving.
The dark cloud drifted ever closer.
He raised his whip up high—
Stop!

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: Stop! I can get them out of the way.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: Hey, how come you're in the story, Grain Buds?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: It's not me, just a girl who happened to pass by. I'm just, er, playing her part.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They're so docile, how could you bear to whip them?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: What do you suggest, then?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Simple. I'll just ask politely. I've got a lot of experience.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: You can talk to animals?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Of course!
The girl who just happened to pass by walked over to the animals and leaned in to listen.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Hey, kid—

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shh!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Well, what are they saying?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Moo?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I... I can't understand them anymore!

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: Hey, Grain Buds!

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: No fair! How come you put yourself in the story? You weren't there!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I told you, it's not me, just a girl who happened to pass by. Must be a student from a nearby school.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: Well, what's her name, then? Was she in the story when Shu told it to you?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You ask too many questions!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Here, you're in the story too! What are you supposed to be, then?

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: I'm a tree! Watch me rain leaves on your head!

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Is it true that you can talk to animals, Grain Buds?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Of course it's true. I've told you so many stories. Did you think I could come up with them all by myself?

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Does the girl who just happened to pass by understand animals too?

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Can I learn to talk to animals?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Well, I've asked a lot of people. Shu, Big Buffalo, and the Doctor. As for the answer...

steps.name: Eager Children
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You can do it, as long as you put your heart into it!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Some animals are very stubborn. It's not easy to get them to talk to people.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But once you understand what they're trying to do, you can understand what they're saying.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Understand what they're trying to do?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: I'm in no mood for jokes!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: The grain in this cart is a new species from Dahuang! The old man at the granary will kill me if it gets wet!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Dahuang? Oh yeah!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Look at the tag on the stockbeast's neck! It came from Dahuang!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Looks like it. How did it get here? It's a long way from Dahuang.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Hey, I recognize you. You were pregnant at the time, and you were following in the rear of the pack, leisurely eating grass and basking in the sun.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What's with all these wounds? What happened to your baby? Did you get separated?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: ...Moo.
The stockbeast bowed her head. The silent burdenbeast took a step towards it, and they cuddled together.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Did you come to find your baby?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll help you find it. Can you tell me about your baby?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: It's a good child.

steps.name: Children
steps.text: It talked!

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: It has large, round eyes. We call it Roundie.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Most of the time, it was quiet and content, following us closely.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: It's a strong child, keeping up with us on its trembling legs.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Does Roundie look like you?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Very much, but not at all to your eyes.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: It's so small and likable... it hangs on to our shoulders lightly with its claws when it sits on us, so as not to hurt us.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But how did you get separated?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: It's not its fault...

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: We had to leave.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Leave Dahuang? Why? If you were looking for fresher pastures, you only needed to go as far as the river bank.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: We kept walking. When there was no path in the hills and rivers, we walked over them by stepping on rocks.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: But our baby was separated from us along the way.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: So you won't move until you find your calf?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Have you any idea how far Dahuang is from here? How long is that search gonna be?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Look at that dark cloud! It could rain at any moment!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Say something, girl!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: How about... how about you two move out of the way and let him pass? I'll stay and help you look for your baby.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: No. There is another reason.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Why won't the burdenbeast talk? Is he here to look for the baby?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: He cannot talk to you yet, for the same reason... a reason that you have not figured out yet.
The young farmer sat down and cocked his head, looking at the dark cloud that was gradually descending, casting a shadow over the trees, road, burdenbeast, stockbeast, and humans.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Are you sleepy? Should we stop here?

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: No! You're just getting to the good part!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shh, keep your voice down, the young ones over there are asleep.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: You can tell it to me quiet, Grain Buds! What did the lost baby look like?

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: The doctor who brought me to Rhodes Island said I have eyes like my mother... does the calf look like its parents?

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: If stockbeasts can talk, their baby can look like anything. It's just a story, no need to care so much.

steps.name: Timid Child
steps.text: Well, I DO care!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shh—do you want to hear what happened next or not? I promise that you'll find out what the calf looks like soon enough.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: What are you muttering to yourself over there? I thought you said you could fix this!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I'm working on it. She should be here like, now... let's wait a little longer.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: What? That rain isn't waiting for anybody!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Just give me a sec!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: I'm sorry. If you don't have a way... I'll have to use my whip.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wait, she's here! Over there!
A Xian came by the road.
She had a few strands of millet in her hand, and there were a few muddy spots on her pants.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: Are you going to the granary?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Yes, Exalted Xian! It's about to rain, and I have to hurry. Look over there...

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: You mean the dark cloud? Don't worry, it won't rain.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: And there's no need to hurry... the road up ahead has collapsed.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Collapsed? How can that be? There shouldn't be any floods in this season.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: Which makes it all the more difficult to predict. Perhaps it was already damaged a few years ago by the mountain fissure, and it finally gave way today.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: You saved his life by blocking the path.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Moo.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You knew the road ahead would collapse?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Is that the other reason?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Partly. He's not the only one we're trying to help.

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Yes. Now that you are aware of the danger ahead, it's time for us to go.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wait! I've figured out the other reason, haven't I? Why doesn't he want to talk to me?

steps.name: Blocking Stockbeast
steps.text: Some words do not need to be said out loud to be understood.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: They're going?
As if just realizing something, the farmer grabbed a bunch of grain from his truck and chased after the burdenbeast and stockbeast.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Wait! Thank you! I want you to have this!

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: *huff* *huff* Wh-Why can't I catch them, even though they're walking so slowly?

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: Those that are gone will remain beyond your grasp. It is the way of things. There is no need for regret.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: Look, the dark cloud is gone, just as I told you.
The dark cloud was indeed gone, and sunlight shined through where it once was.
The young farmer panted with his hands on his knee, but he did not drop a single grain.
Suddenly, there was a sound from the truck. A little beastling poked its head out, then jumped from the cargo bed. It looked just like a dark cloud.
Apparently just woken up, it shook a bunch of straw off itself, having no idea how it got here.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: I smell Mommy and Daddy! Where are they?
The young storm cloudbeast ran a few circles around the truck, leaping up and down.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: Where's Mommy and Daddy? Where am I?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Are you... Roundie?

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: You know me? Hey, you look familiar... have I met you before?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Why were you on the truck?

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: I don't know. I just took a nap in a haystack because the sun was really warm.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: When I woke up, Mommy and Daddy were nowhere to be found! But I could smell them!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They were just here! They're not far away! Look!

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Your mommy and daddy!

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: I... I don't recognize them. I only remember their scent.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: How could you not recognize them?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Your eyes are big and round, just like that stockbeast.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: I don't remember!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But they do... they said you were quiet and content when you were little, always following close behind them.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They said your legs trembled, but you kept walking forward.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They said that when you sat on their shoulders, you always grabbed lightly with your claws so you wouldn't hurt them.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: Th-That's me!
The little storm cloudbeast spun around anxiously, on the verge of tears.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: But I haven't seen them in years!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Your mommy and daddy are over there! I'll take you to them!
The storm cloudbeast jumped into Grain Buds's arms. She sniffed and ran towards the burdenbeast and stockbeast under the red clouds.
She ran and yelled—

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I found your baby!
The silent burdenbeast seemed to hear her, and stopped in its tracks, turning around to wait.
Grain Buds picked up her pace and tried to bring the storm cloudbeast to the burdenbeast.
But she simply could not close the distance with the burdenbeast, no matter how hard she tried.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: I-It's no use. You can't catch them.

steps.name: Stray Storm Cloudbeast
steps.text: They're... gone.
But the burdenbeast was just standing there. It never left.
Grain Buds was exhausted and came to a stop, panting heavily. In the sunset, the shadows were stretched long and thin, like lines of ink that never fade.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: I will do it.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: I will take Roundie to her parents. I will make her recognize them.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: A-Are you really a Xian?

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: There's no such thing as Xians. We're all the same: ordinary people who care with our hearts.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: Isn't that so, girl who just happened to pass by?

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: With our hearts... that's how we hear animals and recognize lost loved ones, right?

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: In that case, I'll leave Roundie in your hands.

steps.name: Passing Xian
steps.text: No need to worry. I promise...

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: You're back! What about the calf?

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: I left it to the Xian. She'll get Roundie to her mommy and daddy.

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: Say, can I hitch a ride?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Sure. Where are you going?

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: If it's not going to rain, I'm in no hurry. I plan to turn around and go to the granary by another way.

steps.name: Girl Passing By
steps.text: I'll go there too! I'll find another way to Dahuang from the granary.

steps.name: Young Farmer
steps.text: Dahuang, eh? That's a long way. Maybe you'll run into that stockbeast and burdenbeast again!
The girl who happened to pass by jumped onto the truck, into the thick layer of straw. Putting her arms behind her head, she gazed at the clouds in the sky.
The trucks started moving. Swaying in the wind, the straws tickled her face, but she did not mind.
The straw, made nice and toasty by the sun, was like the fur of a stockbeast past autumn, taking her into its gentle embrace.
She felt like she was sleeping on top of a stockbeast... or perhaps a burdenbeast, or a storm cloudbeast.
Zzz—

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Asleep already, Grain Buds?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Exalted Xian...

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Oh, your blanket's come off again. Got to cover up with your blanket to get better quickly.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Remember me...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Mommy... Daddy... please... recognize me...

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: You've grown again. This blanket's getting small for you.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Zzz—

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Sleep, Grain Buds. Sweet dreams.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: I'll stay by your side, until you wake.
